# XauCloud

> XauCloud develops automated Gold (XAUUSD) trading technology for MetaTrader 5 and provides a connected Command Center. The site publishes real performance and separately labeled historical strategy tests. Automated trading carries a substantial risk of loss.

## Main pages

- [XauCloud homepage](https://xaucloud.io/)

- [Contact and support](https://xaucloud.io/contact)
- [Trading performance](https://xaucloud.io/performance)
- [Performance history](https://xaucloud.io/performance/history)
- [Gold market outlook](https://xaucloud.io/ai-market-outlook)
- [XauCloud Labs](https://xaucloud.io/labs)
- [Command Center](https://xaucloud.io/command)
